name: 48 Hours
description: This newsmagazine series investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening — and resolution — of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart.

videos.title: The "Unsolvable" Murder of Roxanne Wood
videos.overview: How a DNA “detective,” an undercover cop and a cast-off cigarette butt helped catch a killer. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Last Seen in Breckenridge
videos.overview: In 1982 the bodies of Annette Schnee and Bobbie Jo Oberholtzer were found outside a luxe ski town. A man rescued from a snowdrift the night of the murders turned out to be their killer. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Case Against Michael Politte
videos.overview: At 14 he was accused and later convicted of murdering his mother. But he claims he knows who the real killer is and he’s still out there. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Betrayal of Linda Slaten
videos.overview: After a young mother is murdered, her son unknowingly hangs the killer's photo on his wall. "48 Hours" contributor Jim Axelrod reports.

videos.title: The Tree that Helped Solve a Murder
videos.overview: When a young mother disappears, DNA from a tree helps lead to her killer. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Idaho Student Murders
videos.overview: Four college students are found stabbed to death in their home. Police say the suspect had studied the criminal mind. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Melissa Turner's Closing Act
videos.overview: A cosplay actor finds herself in the spotlight when she's accused of murdering her boyfriend. Can she convince a jury it was self-defense? "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Daughters Who Disappeared
videos.overview: In 1997 four families are shattered when their daughters go missing. As they grieve, one man claims to have answers. Can he be trusted? "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports on the final chapter of a case she started covering more than two decades ago.

videos.title: The Death of an Officer’s Wife
videos.overview: Amanda Perrault died of a gunshot wound to the head. The unusual position of her body raised questions about who pulled the trigger. "48 Hours" contributor Anne-Marie Green reports.

videos.title: The Kidnapping of Michelle and Breea Renee
videos.overview: A mother is forced to rob a bank to save her daughter’s life, then her abductor falsely claims the mother was in on the crime. "48 Hours" contributor Tracy Smith reports.

videos.title: The Brighton Ax Murder
videos.overview: A young mother is killed in her bed, her toddler unharmed. Unsolved for 40 years, how the unusual crime scene helped close the case. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Trial of Alex Murdaugh
videos.overview: "48 Hours" explores the double life of a once prominent lawyer and his stunning fall from grace. Murdaugh is now an admitted drug addict, thief and convicted murderer. "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

videos.title: What Angelina Saw
videos.overview: A young girl peeks out of her bedroom to see blood on the floor and her mother in distress. As an adult she looks back on a night that changed her life. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Remembering the Chowchilla Kidnapping
videos.overview: The segment airing on CBS and streaming on Paramount+ follows the story of the infamous 1976 school bus kidnapping, in which three masked gunmen abducted 26 children and school bus driver Ed Ray. They were buried alive beneath a rock quarry and in an old moving truck, spending more than 16 hours in the dark before they were able to escape.

videos.title: The Mysterious Death of Tiffiney Crawford
videos.overview: A young mother found dead in her car. Could she have shot herself twice? "48 Hours" contributor David Begnaud reports.

videos.title: Kassanndra's Secret
videos.overview: A young woman vanishes. Eerie surveillance video captures a man in a hat. Investigators learn the two are linked by a secret. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: Christy and Hilda's Last Dance
videos.overview: After a night out, two women were dumped outside hospitals by masked men. Were the men good Samaritans or did they play a role in the women’s deaths? "48 Hours" contributor Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

videos.title: Crosley Green's Hard Time
videos.overview: He was free for two years and then sent back to prison for a murder he swears he didn't commit. Yet Green still has faith he'll see his loved ones again. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty has the latest on the case.

videos.title: Alisa Mathewson's Night Terrors
videos.overview: A woman is attacked in her sleep and kidnapped by her estranged husband. The dramatic story of her captivity and rescue. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Lamar Johnson: Standing in Truth
videos.overview: A man gets his life back after spending 28 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. "48 Hours" investigates and is there as Johnson is freed in time to walk his daughter down the aisle. Correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: Where Is Diana Duve?
videos.overview: When a 26-year-old Florida nurse goes missing after a night out, investigators look into her on-again, off-again boyfriend, with whom she was last seen. [also shown as S36:E26]

videos.title: Lori Vallow Daybell: Guilty
videos.overview: "48 Hours" goes inside the case that gripped the nation. A jury in Idaho found Lori Vallow Daybell guilty on all charges, including the murders of her two children and conspiracy to commit murder in the death of her husband's first wife. Contributor Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

videos.title: A Stabbing in Colts Neck
videos.overview: A woman outwits a young stranger who attacked her in her own home. What will it take to find him? "48 Hours" contributor Jim Axelrod reports.

videos.title: The Case of the Poison Cheesecake
videos.overview: Viktoria Nasyrova is accused of using cheesecake as a murder weapon. Her motive was to steal the identity of Olga, who looks a lot like her. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Night of the Idaho Student Murders
videos.overview: New information about the case against Bryan Kohberger for the Nov. 13, 2022, deaths of four University of Idaho students.

videos.title: The Gilgo Beach Serial Killings
videos.overview: After 40 years, police arrest the man they think committed at least 50 rapes and 12 murders. Correspondent Tracy Smith has the latest in the case.

videos.title: The Game Show and the Murder
videos.overview: When Becky Bliefnick was murdered, an answer her husband gave on "Family Feud" years earlier raised eyebrows."48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: Who Wanted Nicki Lenway Dead?
videos.overview: A crime scene investigator is gunned down in broad daylight. The harrowing scene is captured on surveillance video. Who pulled the trigger? "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: Jade Janks and the Secret Photos
videos.overview: A woman discovers explicit photos of herself on her stepfather’s computer. Soon after, he’s found dead. Jade is a likely suspect, but did she do it? "48 Hours" correspondent Tracy Smith reports.

videos.title: Unmasking the Zombie Hunter
videos.overview: How police connected the murders of two young women to a man known as a zombie-fighting comic book hero. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Murder by Clown
videos.overview: How a killer dressed like a clown murdered a mom and almost got away with it. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Hunt for Sarah Yarborough’s Killer
videos.overview: A high school student on her way to drill team practice is found murdered on campus. What it took to close the case after 30 years. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: Stephen Smith: A Death in Murdaugh Country
videos.overview: New evidence discovered after Murdaugh murders reignites a cold case. "48 Hours" obtains findings of independent forensic experts. CBS News national correspondent Nikki Battiste reports.

videos.title: Death at the Front Door: Who Shot Heidi Firkus?
videos.overview: A frantic 911 call captures the sound of a gunshot as a couple reports a break-in. How did the intruder disappear? "48 Hours" contributor Jamie Yuccas reports.

videos.title: Andreen McDonald: A Millionaire Vanishes
videos.overview: How a yellow hammer nailed a suspect in the case of a missing businesswoman. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Journals of Maria Muñoz
videos.overview: A young wife and mother dies unexpectedly with a strange mix of drugs in her system. Investigators turn to her journals for answers. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Suspicious Death of Megan Parra
videos.overview: When a mother of two is found dead in her home, her father obtains death scene photos that help solve the case. "48 Hours" contributor David Begnaud reports.

videos.title: Shootout at the Shaughnessys'
videos.overview: A gunfight in the dead of night. The targets fire back. Their son in the crosshairs of suspicion. "48 Hours" contributor Jim Axelrod reports.

videos.title: For the Love of Cayley Mandadi
videos.overview: After their daughter’s violent death, a mother and stepfather track down the suspect’s car for answers. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Capturing Moriah Wilson’s Killer
videos.overview: A promising young athlete is murdered. Her suspected killer disappears and an international manhunt by U.S. Marshals begins. “48 Hours” contributor Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

videos.title: Who Took Our Dad? The Abduction of Ray Wright
videos.overview: After a beloved family man vanishes suddenly, a high-speed chase gives police a lead that suggests he was abducted and murdered in a revenge plot. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: Justice for Amie Harwick
videos.overview: Amie Harwick's roommate speaks out about trying to save her and helping to convict her killer. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Assassination of Jeff German
videos.overview: A Las Vegas journalist is stabbed to death while investigating claims a boss was toxic. Did his reporting make him a target? "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The People v. Kouri Richins
videos.overview: When her husband is found dead of an apparent overdose, Kouri Richins writes a children's book about grief. Soon after she’s charged with his murder. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Menendez Brothers' Fight for Freedom
videos.overview: The Menendez brothers were given life sentences for gunning down their own parents. Now they’re hoping new evidence could reopen the case. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Monica Sementilli Affair
videos.overview: When a renowned hairstylist is killed poolside, investigators look at his wife. Was her alleged affair with her racquetball coach a motive for murder? "48 Hours" contributor Michelle Miller reports.

videos.title: Who Poisoned Angela Craig?
videos.overview: A mother of six becomes deathly ill with unusual symptoms. Investigators suspect she was murdered with a poison protein shake."48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Troubled Case Against Jane Dorotik
videos.overview: A woman convicted of murdering her husband discovers serious problems with some key evidence used against her at trial. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Conspiracy to Murder Jennifer Dulos
videos.overview: On May 24, 2019, Jennifer Farber Dulos dropped off her five children at school, drove to her Connecticut home, and was never seen again. Dulos' estranged husband, Fotis Dulos, was charged with her murder, but after he died by suicide the focus turned to his girlfriend, Michelle Troconis. On March 1, 2024, Troconis was found guilty of conspiring with Fotis Dulos to murder Jennifer Dulos and covering it up.

videos.title: The Disappearance of Maddi Kingsbury
videos.overview: A young Minnesota mother goes missing. Her sister turns to TikTok for help. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Death By Eye Drops
videos.overview: A caregiver is accused of poisoning her friend with eye drops. She says investigators got it wrong. "48 Hours" contributor Jericka Duncan reports.

videos.title: Kristen Trickle: Autopsy of the Mind
videos.overview: A Kansas woman is found dying from a gunshot wound. Evidence at the scene doesn’t add up, so a prosecutor gets creative. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Detective's Wife
videos.overview: Police in Massachusetts investigate one of their own when a detective becomes a suspect in the shooting death of his wife. "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

videos.title: The Day My Mother Vanished
videos.overview: When her mother disappears, 7-year-old Nicki Bates begins a lifelong search to find her and bring her killer to justice. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Puzzling Death of Susann Sills
videos.overview: The wife of a fertility doctor is found dead at the bottom of a staircase. Did her dogs play a role in her death or was the scene staged to cover a murder? "48 Hours" correspondent Tracy Smith reports.

videos.title: The Case of the Black Swan (1)
videos.overview: A former ballerina shoots her husband. Did she kill to save herself or was it out of spite? Contributor Jim Axelrod reports in part one of a two-part "48 Hours."

videos.title: The Case of the Black Swan (2)
videos.overview: For the first time, the former ballerina dubbed "The Black Swan” tells her story of why she shot and killed her estranged husband. Contributor Jim Axelrod reports in the second part of a two-part "48 Hours."

videos.title: The Life and Death of Blaze Bernstein
videos.overview: A brilliant college student is killed by a former classmate. Inside the trial of the secret neo-Nazi prosecutors say murdered Blaze because he was gay and Jewish.

videos.title: The Unending Search for Sara Anne Wood
videos.overview: Investigators are locked in a 30-year game of cat and mouse with a child serial killer to find the body of 12-year-old Sara. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Bathtub Murder of Kendy Howard
videos.overview: Did a former Idaho state trooper use his law enforcement skills to stage his wife's death in their bathtub? "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Depraved Heart Murder
videos.overview: Sarah Harris was a bright, young Maryland woman who dreamed of a career in medicine. On the morning of Jan. 26, 2022, she was found unresponsive on the floor of the home she shared with her boyfriend, Dr. James Ryan. Ryan told police it was an overdose, but Harris’ family believed he was responsible. Contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

videos.title: Where is Jermain Charlo?
videos.overview: Police have searched for 23-year-old mother Jermain Charlo since she vanished in June 2018 from Missoula, Montana. Now, six years after she disappeared, police release the last known images of the missing mom. Can this security camera video help reveal what happened to her?

videos.title: Who Killed Aileen Seiden in Room 15?
videos.overview: Three people check into a Florida motel room. Only two walk out alive. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Strange Shooting of Alex Pennig
videos.overview: A nurse is found dead in her apartment. Surveillance video captures her coming home for the last time. Can investigators piece together what happened next? "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: Fatal First Date
videos.overview: A couple's first date ends with an ambush. Both are shot. Can the only survivor identify the shooter?

videos.title: Tracking the Killer of Mary Catherine Edwards
videos.overview: A schoolteacher is murdered in her own home. Years later investigators discover she was a bridesmaid at the killer's wedding. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Plot to Eliminate Alyssa Burkett
videos.overview: A toxic couple orchestrates an elaborate plan to kill a mother. Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: The Firefighter's Secret
videos.overview: A young woman is found dead in her burning home. She'd been involved with a firefighter — could he have set a fire to cover her murder? "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

videos.title: The "Batman" Intruder
videos.overview: Morgan Metzer is attacked in her home by a masked intruder disguising his voice to sound like Batman. Her ex-husband comes to her aid, but is he a hero? "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

videos.title: The Search for JonBenét's Killer
videos.overview: Is there new hope to solve the murder of JonBenét Ramsey? Her father says there's a way.

videos.title: The Blackout Murder of Livye Lewis
videos.overview: A woman is discovered shot dead in her car with a blood-covered man alive on the ground. The man says he has no memory of how he got there. Investigators unravel the strange scene. 48 Hours correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Deputy Spivey on Trial
videos.overview: Former TV bailiff Renard Spivey found himself in a real-life courtroom drama when he was accused of killing his wife in 2019. He speaks out for the first time about the fight to prove his innocence in an interview with 48 Hours contributor Natalie Morales.

videos.title: Unraveling the Case Against Melissa Calusinski
videos.overview: Was key evidence manipulated to help convict a day care worker of murder? "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: The Ivy League Murder
videos.overview: A road rage incident unravels into a story of obsession and premeditation when Yale graduate student and former National Army Guardsman Kevin Jiang is gunned down in New Haven, Connecticut.

videos.title: The No Body Case of Dee Warner
videos.overview: When a woman disappears, her children are certain she's been murdered. But without a body, they know it will be hard to get justice. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: It's About Danni
videos.overview: When 15-year-old Danni Houchins is found dead in a swamp, her family says they were led to believe she drowned. 24 years later, Danni's sister learns the terrible truth. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: Justine's Voice
videos.overview: After a teenager is strangled and buried alive, her family takes on the fight to keep her convicted killers behind bars. "We're her voice" says Justine's sister. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Hit-and-Run Homicide of Davis McClendon
videos.overview: When South Carolina authorities found Davis McClendon dead by the road near his wrecked car, they suspected a hit-and-run. But his newfound love is convinced it was not accident.

videos.title: Cati Blauvelt: Death of a Soldier's Wife
videos.overview: Shortly after former Army recruiter John Blauvelt was questioned about the fatal stabbing of his estranged wife Cati Blauvelt in South Carolina, he went on the run with his then-17-year-old girlfriend, Hannah Thompson. What does she know?

videos.title: Could Angela Prichard Have Been Saved?
videos.overview: A woman repeatedly called police for help when she was attacked, stalked, and intimidated by her husband. It didn't stop him from killing her. "48 Hours" contributor Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

videos.title: Dead Girls Don't Talk
videos.overview: A man charged with murder for poisoning two women tells a friend, "dead girls don't talk." Brave survivors speak out on their behalf. "48 Hours" contributor Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

videos.title: The Day My Mother Never Came Home
videos.overview: Did a father use his 6-year-old son as an alibi for murder? Reggie Reed Jr. grapples with his parents' troubled past. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: First Love, Then Murder
videos.overview: When Oregon teen Ellen Friar disappears, investigators discover her forbidden relationship led to murder. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: The Farris Wheel
videos.overview: Melody Farris, the matriarch of a wealthy family, spins a tale trying to pin the murder of her husband on her own son.

videos.title: The Boy Across the Street
videos.overview: College student Catina Rose Salarno is killed by her boyfriend who lived right across the street. Decades later, her family is still battling to keep him in prison.

videos.title: Facing a Monster
videos.overview: As a teenager, C.C. Opanowski survives a vicious attack by an ex-boyfriend. Years later, she faces him in court after he murders a young mother.

videos.title: The Footprint
videos.overview: Jeanie Ann Childs is murdered in her home in south Minneapolis and the pivotal clue at the crime is a bloody footprint her killer left behind.

videos.title: My Mother's Murder Trials (1)
videos.overview: Dana Chandler's own daughter believes she committed a double murder. Years later, courtroom drama brings unsettling answers.

videos.title: My Mother's Murder Trials (2)
videos.overview: A daughter suspects her mother of a double murder. Years later, courtroom drama brings unsettling answers.

videos.title: Coached To Kill
videos.overview: A preview of the case of a high school softball coach accused of recruiting a former player to kill her ex-boyfriend.

videos.title: The Boy Who Killed His Twin
videos.overview: Seventeen-year-old Benjamin Elliott fatally stabs his twin sister, Meghan, in the middle of the night – a crime with no known motive and an act his defense claims he committed while sleepwalking. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports.

videos.title: Murder in the Parking Garage
videos.overview: For years, Kenneth Fandrich told everyone he knew that he was being stalked by the nicest man in town. In 2023, after his wife calls 911 to report her husband missing, police discover his lifeless body in his car, parked inside a corporate parking garage. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

videos.title: A Death in the Stairwell
videos.overview: After her husband, Kevin Davis, is found dying at the foot of the stairs, a woman accused of murder fights to clear her name. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

videos.title: My Uncle Joe's Murder
videos.overview: Joe Shymanski was gunned down in the driveway of his Calvert County, Maryland, home in 2023. Now his niece mourns her uncle's murder and questions whether the convicted killer was the only one involved.

videos.title: Closing the Cold Case of Robin Lawrence
videos.overview: Robin Lawrence was home alone with her 2-year-old daughter in Springfield, Virginia, when an unknown killer murdered her. Her toddler was left to fend for herself for two days until Robin’s body was discovered. Nearly 30 years later, cold case detectives uncovered a surprising suspect. "48 Hours" correspondent Anne-Marie Green reports.

videos.title: The Han Family Murders
videos.overview: A beloved doctor, his wife, and their young daughter are murdered, leaving their Santa Barbara, California, community reeling. A suspect emerges with a fantastical story of shadowy figures and intrigue straight out of a spy thriller.

videos.title: Tracker Dakota Black
videos.overview: Lieutenant Dakota Black is a trained tracker and detective with the Pottawatomie County Sheriff’s Office. When Makayla Meave goes missing, Black launches an investigation that leads to the discovery of the young mother found murdered.

videos.title: The Setup Murder of Kristil Krug
videos.overview: A stalker sends menacing messages to a young mother before she is murdered. The investigation reveals a sinister setup.

videos.title: Help Find Molly Bish's Killer
videos.overview: Molly Bish was just 16 years old when she went missing on June 27, 2000. She vanished after being dropped off at her lifeguarding job. What followed became the largest search in Massachusetts history. Her remains were eventually discovered, but her killer has never been identified. Decades later, Bish’s sister turns to social media, sharing her family’s story and urging the public to help generate new leads.

videos.title: Joe Hunter's Mission
videos.overview: Joe Hunter's emotional tribute to his late sister Joanna became one of the most talked-about moments of season 48 of "Survivor". Joanna’s death was officially ruled a suicide, but Joe says she was murdered and has made it his mission to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Coached to Kill
videos.overview: When a high school softball coach and one of her former players are arrested for the murder of Indiana man Shea Briar, the coach places all the blame on the player. Prosecutors, however, say the coach orchestrated the killing.

videos.title: The Gaslighting of Hannah Pettey
videos.overview: When a gravely ill young woman is rushed to the hospital, doctors make a shocking discovery: she has an “astronomical” amount of lead in her body. What begins as a medical mystery quickly becomes a criminal investigation. Hannah Pettey, a young mother from Alabama, suffered debilitating pain and lost more than 45 pounds in the months prior as her health rapidly declined. Investigators focus on the two people she trusted the most as the police work to uncover who was poisoning Hannah, and why.

videos.title: Melissa Rocuba's Final Moments
videos.overview: A Pennsylvania man claims a freak accident while handling his gun caused the death of his wife, Melissa Rocuba. Bruno Rocuba was not arrested or charged with any crime. Years later, investigators uncover disturbing new evidence that challenges Bruno Rocuba’s story, including surveillance audio capturing his wife’s final moments. The recording raises haunting questions about what really happened in that bedroom and whether Melissa Rocuba’s death was truly an accident.

videos.title: The Mother I Wish I Knew
videos.overview: When Debe Atrops was murdered, her daughter, Rhianna Stephens, was just 8 months old. More than 30 years later, a cold case team from Washington County took a fresh look at the case by talking to witnesses and running new tests on old evidence. The team thought they had enough to prosecute Debe’s estranged husband at the time of her murder, Bob Atrops, who is also Stephens’s father. Stephens is convinced they have the wrong man—after losing her mother, she fears losing her father too.

videos.title: The Sneak Attack on Katlyn Lyon
videos.overview: When Katlyn Lyon Montgomery died in October 2022, her mother turned to TikTok to share her grief and demand justice. As the case evolved from a possible accident to a homicide, she built an online community to help hold Katlyn’s killer accountable.

videos.title: The Rx Defense
videos.overview: On December 23, 2023, police were called to a Texas home where two teenagers had been shot. Eighteen-year-old Ethan Riley died from his injuries, while 19-year-old Ben Bliek survived. Their friend, 17-year-old Connor Hilton, was arrested and later confessed to the shooting. He claims the shooting was triggered by a reaction to a popular prescription acne medication, saying it caused him to experience homicidal thoughts. Prosecutors, however, reject that explanation and say the evidence points elsewhere.

videos.title: The Girl from Wahoo
videos.overview: In 1969, 17-year-old Mary Kay Hesse was stabbed to death in Wahoo, Nebraska. For more than 50 years, the murder remained unsolved. But advances in investigative techniques and renewed focus by law enforcement helped piece together long-overlooked evidence, ultimately leading to an arrest.

videos.title: Sade Robinson and the Secret Beach
videos.overview: When a college student in Milwaukee vanishes after a first date, investigators race to retrace her final movements. Using data from an app on her phone, law enforcement begins to piece together where she went—and whom she was with. As the investigation focuses on a man named Maxwell Anderson, chilling security camera footage and evidence discovered on a secluded beach raise urgent questions about what happened to Sade Robinson.

videos.title: The Woman Who Died Twice
videos.overview: When a woman’s remains found in a swamp outside Savannah are identified, friends are stunned. They had been told Mindi Kassotis died in a hospital. But five months later, authorities say she was murdered. Investigators work to unravel how she appeared to die twice, and what really happened in the months between.

videos.title: Jocelyn Peters and the Notebook
videos.overview: The murder of third grade teacher Jocelyn Peters baffled investigators in St. Louis, Missouri, from the start. The crime scene contained unusual clues, such as potato fragments splattered near the victim, and the behavior of a person of interest before a police interview caught detectives’ attention. Why did this man eat pages from a notebook when facing questions about Jocelyn’s murder? What did investigators believe the notebook might reveal?

videos.title: What the Neighbors Saw
videos.overview: Late at night in Barron County, Wisconsin, a couple watches as a rolled-up carpet is carted out of a nearby home. Soon after they learn the combative neighbor who lived there, Gary Herbst, is missing.

videos.title: Denise and Aaron Quinn Get the Last Word
videos.overview: A high-profile kidnapping case that drew national attention, and was the subject of a 2024 Netflix docuseries, takes a new turn. Denise Huskins Quinn and Aaron Quinn worked with law enforcement to help uncover additional crimes committed by their attacker, Matthew Muller. In doing so, the Quinns helped bring justice to other victims and found a way to reclaim their own story.

videos.title: The Root Beer Float Murder
videos.overview: What begins as a burglary investigation quickly turns into something far more sinister. When a thief is caught in the act, he sends police down a trail of evidence that reveals the murder of Harold Allen, involving thousands of text messages, unusual poisons and a root beer float. How did a sweet treat become central to a deadly crime?

videos.title: Kimberly Langwell’s Hidden Grave
videos.overview: Tiffani McInnis was a teenager when her mother, Kimberly Langwell, failed to return home from work, leaving her family searching for answers. More than 20 years later, detectives in Beaumont, Texas, received critical information that would lead to a secret grave and a horrific discovery that finally revealed Kimberly Langwell’s fate.

videos.title: Jade Colvin is Missing
videos.overview: The last known sighting of a missing teenager leads investigators to a remote Iowa farm, where photos discovered on an old cell phone reveal critical clues. As law enforcement works to make sense of the evidence, those images help them put the pieces together and determine what happened to 14-year-old Jade Colvin.

videos.title: The Killing of Theresa Fusco
videos.overview: In 1984, 16-year-old Theresa Fusco vanished after leaving her job at a local roller rink. Nearly 41 years later, a breakthrough involving DNA from a smoothie straw has finally brought new answers.

videos.title: The Love Bombing of Gloria Choi
videos.overview: Gloria Choi, a young single mother from Washington, had a chance meeting that led to what appeared to be a dream romance. Her new boyfriend, Billy Rickman, showered her with attention, convincing those around her that he was deeply devoted. But investigators would later uncover a far more troubling reality. As police pieced together what was real and what was deception, the investigation revealed how the relationship spiraled into violence and ended in murder.

videos.title: Beverly Hills 911
videos.overview: When Beverly Hills police respond to a 911 call at a mansion, they discover a widow, Violet Yacobi, dead below a staircase. How did she end up on the marble floor of her entryway, and was her death the result of a tragic accident or something more sinister?

videos.title: The Man with Two Names
videos.overview: After a conviction in the arson death of billionaire in Monaco, Ted Maher changes his name and puts out a hit on his estranged wife in New Mexico. He denies it all.

videos.title: Kouri Richins: Behind the Facade
videos.overview: Kouri Richins, the Utah mother who made headlines for publishing a children’s book about grief after her husband’s death, was sentenced just last week to life in prison without parole for his murder. Prosecutors argued she poisoned her husband, Eric Richins, in a case that drew national attention. Now, jurors who heard the evidence are speaking out about what led them to convict her, including what they believe motivated the crime and why they reached their verdict.
